scope: External methods used as comparators or representation sources in this project; original pixels plus independent target truth are required.

models.original_test: EV9V official test: 888 cines / nine codes
models.compatible_endpoint: 800 native cines mapped to five families; full nine-code endpoint baseline-only
models.limit: Same EV9V source and historically inspected test, not independent external confirmation. New official 61ea9b6 is distinct from project-pinned 532f60b.

models.original_test: Guangdong hospital: 4625 standard-view test cines / 38 classes; 200 OOD test
models.limit: Official repository has labels/template splits, not the original cine test bundle. CAMUS quality experiment is a different task.

models.original_test: 4000 internal test videos / 58 views; institutional clinical cohorts
models.limit: Original expert 58-view truth unavailable; released project classifier has 11 coarse outputs. Public MIMIC pixels do not supply original expert view truth.
Released original package contains I3D features and action labels; frozen cardiac five-class model cannot consume/predict that contract.
Feature/action original benchmark is not a cardiac cine recognition test.
Action boundaries and labels are incompatible with frozen A08 outputs.
Action feature/label task; official repository also distinguishes replacement replication weights from lost original weights.

models.original_test: 5447 static test images / three expert annotations / 47 views
models.limit: No directly obtainable complete pixel/annotation test package verified. Static images cannot be repeated into an invented 16-frame cine test.

models.original_test: Private Toronto/Chicago view test; public EchoNet LVEF tests
models.compatible_endpoint: Auxiliary A4C source check on EchoNet-Dynamic; not comparable with LVEF MAE
models.limit: Paper view task says 12 classes; released view configuration says 13 and references private UHN CSVs. No original view-test bundle.

models.original_test: Private clinical study test; public EchoNet-Dynamic / EchoNet-LVH measurement endpoints
models.compatible_endpoint: Auxiliary A4C / PLAX source checks, not clinical or measurement endpoint comparison
models.limit: Original tasks are clinical interpretation / regression. Frozen A08 has no EF or wall-thickness output.
Code / four-row example / weights do not provide original full test pixels, annotations or split. A08 predicts views, not boxes.
Classifier-guided planes are not independent true A4C/A5C cine labels.

models.original_test: TMED-2 still images, CAMUS segmentation, EchoNet regression and private cine tasks
models.compatible_endpoint: Auxiliary CAMUS 4CH-coded source check; not segmentation Dice or quality accuracy
models.limit: Still-image, segmentation and regression scores cannot be compared with cardiac view accuracy. No new independent A5C cine test verified.

additional_resources.name: EchoXFlow
additional_resources.disposition: Public cine pixels, but released view labels are model predictions; not independent expert test truth.

additional_resources.name: Unity Imaging
additional_resources.disposition: Sparse still frames, evaluation-only project restriction; no dense cine test. Potential EchoFine source overlap unverified.

additional_resources.name: MedSapiens / EchoNet Measurements
additional_resources.disposition: Landmarks/measurement targets; no directly matched A4C/A5C view endpoint.

additional_resources.name: Pediatric
additional_resources.disposition: Existing project permissions/history restrictions retained; not a new untouched test and not included in this run.
